name: MD Ziauddin
headline: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) & Senior AI Systems Engineer | Voice AI (1M+ Calls), LLMs, Hybrid RAG, Distributed Systems
about: Senior Software Engineer and Forward Deployed AI Engineer with 5+ years of experience architecting full-stack platforms, real-time distributed systems, and production-grade Voice AI & GenAI workflows. Proven track record of scaling enterprise Voice AI deployments to 1,000,000+ outbound calls, reducing fintech platform latency by 90%, and delivering mission-critical software for global enterprises including VMware.

description: Promoted from Software Engineer within 3 months to spearhead enterprise Voice AI deployments, owning end-to-end solution architecture from design through production launch and optimization.
Architected and deployed autonomous Voice AI workflows for enterprise healthcare campaigns, reliably processing 1,000,000+ outbound calls and driving multi-account expansion.
Profiled and benchmarked diverse combinations of LLMs, Speech-to-Text (STT), and Text-to-Speech (TTS) models to establish optimal latency-accuracy configurations.
Engineered bidirectional integrations between Voice AI agents, scheduling engines, and enterprise CRMs (Odoo, LeadSquared), generating 50+ qualified patient consultations in month one.
Served as primary engineering liaison for enterprise e-commerce Voice AI rollouts, leading live production triage, root-cause validation, and cross-team incident resolution.
Engineered a dynamic contextual filler system to mask LLM inference and backend network latency, significantly reducing perceived response wait times (~380ms TTFA) during live voice calls.
Built an automated LLM-based QA and compliance pipeline to audit call recordings against operational SOPs and proprietary scoring matrices at scale.
Designed a real-time, rule-based notification framework (broadcast and user-specific alerts) and automated campaign analytics reporting infrastructure.
Architected the core overhaul of an AI-powered fintech platform, reducing application latency by 90% and accelerating release velocity by 40% through scalable system design.
Designed and implemented a bidirectional WebSocket communication layer, transforming a static web application into a low-latency, interactive AI assistant experience.
Owned technical architecture, code reviews, and multi-release delivery for flagship AI Assistant and Referral Engine initiatives across product and engineering teams.
Created a standardized React Google Apps Script (GAS) framework to unify frontend development, while mentoring 4 junior engineers in system design and code quality.
As a key engineer in a client-facing role, I translated complex enterprise needs into innovative and tangible software solutions, from initial concept to full-scale deployment.

Spearheaded multiple proof-of-concepts (POCs) using React and Node.js, rapidly translating abstract ideas into functional prototypes that secured stakeholder buy-in and led to green-lighting two major enterprise development projects.

Drove the end-to-end development of critical cloud-native projects on AWS for large-scale enterprise clients, engineering efficient and scalable full-stack solutions that directly contributed to securing repeat business and follow-on contracts.

Engineered robust solutions for complex integration challenges, ensuring seamless data flow and front-end performance that consistently met and exceeded enterprise-level security and reliability standards.
Took ownership of critical front-end initiatives, focusing on modernization, security, and seamless user experience for core VMware products.
Led migration of user authentication system to OAuth 2.0, eliminated legacy vulnerabilities, and improved product security.
Sole UI engineer for company rebranding, rebuilt key UIs with React, improved brand experience product-wide.
Developed complex customer-facing features for licensing/subscription portal, making critical revenue-generating journeys more intuitive.
Delivered key data visualization features using AntV G6 as part of a 50-person team
Implemented Charts and visualization mapping interconnectivity between VMs using AntV G6
Built MERN stack apps; strong understanding of JavaScript and React.
Translated Figma designs into high-quality, reusable React components.
Wrote maintainable, reusable code as a foundation for the application's UI.
Managed 100+ desktops, programmed .bat automations (50% faster setup), designed DB schema with SQL/Python

recommendations.text: At VMware, Zia and I worked together on multiple critical project during his tenure of 1 year. For me and many of us from back-end team, Zia is the go to person for front-end features. Zia's due diligence and efforts to know the E2E use-case for the functionality that he was working on was really impressive. This help us in many cases to deliver performance optimized front-end and back-end integration. He is really passionate about his work which enabled us to deliver the mission critical project in time with quality.

projects.title: Articulate AI
projects.description: Interviews are tough. The pressure, the need to be sharp, and the challenge of clearly communicating complex ideas can be overwhelming. I wanted to build something to help people overcome that anxiety. That's the "why" behind Articulate AI.
